about.heading: About Me
about.content:
I am an operations and analytics professional with a dual Master's background in Operational Research and Business Analytics. Currently, I serve as the operational backbone for two postgraduate programmes at Hong Kong Baptist University's Business School, where I manage end-to-end programme administration, provide direct student consultation to diverse international cohorts, and support data-driven curriculum evaluation.

My approach combines analytical rigour with operational efficiency. I leverage modern tools — including AI-assisted workflows — to streamline processes, reduce manual overhead, and deliver timely insights, while always grounding decisions in context and human judgment. I do not outsource thinking to machines; I use them to amplify it.

I am seeking opportunities in internet finance operations, university business school administration (with financial-industry connectivity), and client-facing roles in traditional finance (relationship management, wealth management). I thrive in English-speaking professional environments and bring native Mandarin and basic Cantonese to cross-cultural teams.
